stem.text: A student uses a spring gun to launch a steel ball with a constant horizontal velocity. He varies the height $h$ of the gun and measures the horizontal displacement $r$ of the ball when it hits the ground.

stem.alt: Diagram of a spring gun on a grey block launching a steel ball horizontally, with a height h and a horizontal distance r marked, and a series of ball positions shown in flight.

stem.text: Which graph shows the variation with height $h$ of the horizontal displacement $r$?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled r and horizontal axis labelled h, origin marked 0, and a curve.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled r and horizontal axis labelled h, origin marked 0, and a curve.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled r and horizontal axis labelled h, origin marked 0, and a curve.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled r and horizontal axis labelled h, origin marked 0, and a straight line.
